gloss_en: Same bridge exported three ways gives three very different IFC files; which one will the client send back?
title_original: Same bridge, three IFC files: which one will your client send back?
question_paraphrase: one bridge exported three ways: 161 proxies, random GlobalIds, no quantities, national-grid mm coordinates making viewers jitter. How to tell a good file from a bad one?
phrasing_notes: practitioner essay, concrete counts, 'valid is not complete'
answer_summary: Write the client's needs as an IDS, set classes/parts in the authoring tool, inspect for proxies/CRS/quantities, then validate with schema + buildingSMART Validation Service + IDS.

gloss_en: AI invents IFC property sets that sound standard but do not exist.
title_original: Can you trust AI with IFC properties? 4 ways it makes them up
question_paraphrase: AI gave me Pset_BuildingElementCommon and put IsExternal on footings; how do I know which property sets are real?
answer_summary: LLMs predict patterns: they invent Pset_ names, attach famous properties everywhere, confuse similar names and use abstract classes. Verify against the buildingSMART schema; allow 'I don't know'; demand source quotes.

gloss_en: What is an IFC concept and how many does a bridge pier need?
title_original: What is an IFC concept? One bridge pier carries 18 of them
question_paraphrase: what exactly is an 'IFC concept', which are in the Reference View vs Alignment-based View, and what can IDS check?
answer_summary: A concept is an agreed pattern for storing one kind of information. IFC 4.3 has 99; Reference View 51, Alignment-based 64; IDS 1.0 fully checks 22 and partly 10 (author's analysis).

gloss_en: IFC is no miracle weapon: parametric objects arrive as dumb objects in the partner's software.
title_original: Die Wunderwaffe IFC
question_paraphrase: partner imports my IFC and windows/walls come as plain dumb objects; is IFC supposed to be lossless?
answer_summary: Parametric intelligence is not fully covered by IFC and every tool has its own logic; expect gaps rather than blame a single tool.

gloss_en: IFC 5 as a new hope for interoperability: IFC is slow, heavy, monolithic, no incremental updates.
title_original: IFC 5: Eine neue Hoffnung für Interoperabilität
question_paraphrase: why is IFC criticized as heavy and STEP-based, and what will IFC 5 (ECS, JSON, incremental) change?
context_given: interview with buildingSMART and Autodesk people
answer_summary: Complaints: monolithic packages, no collaborative/incremental mechanism, unrealistic lossless expectations. IFC 5: entity-component system, JSON, partial updates; Validation Service scorecards meanwhile.

gloss_en: Foundations modelled with Revit wall tool export as IfcWall; how to get IfcFooting?
title_original: Wand als IfcFooting exportieren
question_paraphrase: meine Fundamentwaende aus dem Wandwerkzeug werden IfcWall statt IfcFooting
answer_summary: Add IfcExportAs=IfcFooting to wall type/instance and set wall Function to Foundation or Retaining, otherwise it still exports IfcWall.

gloss_en: Revit has several origins; where does my IFC land in other software and does shared coordinates matter for GIS?
title_original: Revit, IFC und Koordinatensysteme
question_paraphrase: model lands in the wrong place or invisible in viewer after IFC export; which Revit origin should be used?
context_given: Project Base Point, Survey Point, shared coordinates
answer_summary: Export from a local origin (Project Base Point kept at internal origin), treat georeferencing separately (IFC4 embeds map conversion), avoid shared coordinates far from building, use coordination volumes, link origin to origin.

gloss_en: Many IFC export issues come from an outdated Revit IFC exporter add-in.
title_original: Aktuelle Revit IFC Exporter
question_paraphrase: which IFC exporter version do I have and where to get the newest?
answer_summary: Install the newest exporter per Revit version from Autodesk App Store or GitHub; if the dialog shows no version number you use the bundled outdated one.

gloss_en: Type parameters no longer export through user-defined property sets in new exporter versions.
title_original: Revit Typenparameter nach IFC exportieren
question_paraphrase: type parameters missing in IFC after exporter update; user-defined pset file worked before
answer_summary: List the type class (IfcWallType, IfcDoorStyle for 2x3 doors) in the parameter set file, keep T/I flag; a family parameter named TypeName can block the built-in Type Name.

gloss_en: Linked IFC vs Autodesk Data Exchange in Revit: size, performance, use cases.
title_original: IFC verlinken vs. Data Exchange laden in Revit
question_paraphrase: linked IFC bloats my project; should I use Data Exchange instead?
context_given: IFC link creates hidden .ifc.rvt from a template
answer_summary: Set a minimal empty template for IFC links to avoid bloat; IFC remains best for submissions and handover, DX for granular sharing; test both.

gloss_en: ProvisionForVoid openings must cut hosts in Revit and show properties; open vs link vs bind.
title_original: IFC ProvisionForVoid in Revit - Öffnen vs. Referenzieren / Binden
question_paraphrase: openings from IFC dont cut the walls in Revit, properties on types
answer_summary: Link IFC then bind link so openings become native instances that can cut; downside: no simple updates from source.

gloss_en: Revit exports one phase at a time; demolished elements and phase data are lost in IFC.
title_original: Revit Phasen nach IFC exportieren
question_paraphrase: how to get phase created/demolished into IFC
answer_summary: Export per phase, filter in viewer, compare phases via Docs versions, add custom pset with Phase created/demolished.

gloss_en: Not all IFC parameters exist in Revit by default; use IFC shared parameter files; material layers differ after export.
title_original: IFC Shared Parameters
question_paraphrase: which IFC shared parameters do I add, and why do material layers differ from Revit?
answer_summary: Add parameters from the shipped shared-parameter text files (Revit IFCExporter Parameters group) and fill them; exact spelling and data type needed.

gloss_en: Revit exports only one IfcSite and IfcBuilding; how to fill project/site/building and show MEP systems separately?
title_original: IFC Struktur - IfcProject, IfcSite, IfcFacility
question_paraphrase: how to get multiple sites or buildings and site-specific properties in IFC from Revit
answer_summary: Fill via Project Information and shared parameters; link Revit models into one IfcProject for multiple sites/buildings; IFC 4.3 facility types for infrastructure.

gloss_en: Exported material properties are not visible in every IFC viewer, especially for multilayer walls.
title_original: Materialeigenschaften in IFC
question_paraphrase: I exported material properties but the viewer does not show them
answer_summary: Check in a text editor whether the property is in the file; viewer display matters less than machine readers.

gloss_en: Elements on levels not flagged Building Story land on the wrong IfcBuildingStorey.
title_original: IfcBuildingStorey
question_paraphrase: elements end up on the wrong floor in IFC
answer_summary: Use IfcSpatialContainer parameter with target level name, or IfcBuilding/IfcSite to bypass storeys.

gloss_en: Which free IFC viewers are most popular, and why keep one vendor-neutral viewer for cross-checks?
title_original: Die populärsten IFC Viewer
question_paraphrase: which IFC viewer should I use to cross-check my exports?
answer_summary: Vendor-neutral viewers: FZKViewer, ODA open IFC Viewer, BIMcollab ZOOM, BIM Vision; criteria: cost, platform, features, IFC version support.

gloss_en: Revit columns have no Function so Pset_ColumnCommon.IsExternal is empty; map a custom Yes/No parameter.
title_original: IFC Tipp: Revit-Stütze den IsExternal Standardparameter zuweisen
question_paraphrase: IsExternal not filled for columns; since Revit 2023 type parameters no longer export to Pset_Common
answer_summary: Create Yes/No parameter, add tab-separated line to mapping file with exact IFC names; instance parameters required in newer versions.

gloss_en: What I don't like about IFC: documentation looks 20 years old, confusing version names, too many acronyms, redundant Ifc prefix.
title_original: What I don't like about IFC
question_paraphrase: why is it IFC2x3, IFC4add1, TC1 - what happened to number three? and why is the documentation so hard to navigate?
answer_summary: Author still calls IFC the best scheme; says much criticism stems from poor configuration, weak implementation and messy model management.

gloss_en: 10 common IFC export mistakes part 1: wrong project names, proxies, too many objects, other disciplines placeholders, extra storeys.
title_original: 10 Common IFC Export Mistakes to Avoid (Part 1)
question_paraphrase: my IFC has proxies and extra storeys, duplicates of other disciplines walls
answer_summary: Fix mapping table, export from a dedicated filtered view, model development matrix, do not flag supporting levels as storeys; inspect in neutral viewer.

gloss_en: 10 common IFC export mistakes part 2: too many/few properties, wrong base point, over-detailed geometry, wrong spatial hierarchy.
title_original: 10 Common IFC Export Mistakes to Avoid (Part 2)
question_paraphrase: models are rotated/misplaced and clash everything; furniture is under storey instead of space so FM sees rooms empty
answer_summary: Write per-software how-tos from EIR, follow BEP coordinates, check triangle counts, inspect IFC tree vs expected hierarchy.

gloss_en: Is the industry ready for IFC4? Test on a 400-model hospital project says stay with IFC2x3.
title_original: Is the industry ready for IFC4?
question_paraphrase: IFC4 exports lose geometry, change property sets and show glitches; should we switch from IFC2x3?
answer_summary: No: certification lags, nobody requires IFC4, performance gain small (7-30%); stay on IFC2x3 when building from models.

gloss_en: IFC export rules and pain points per purpose: coordination, QS, construction, FM.
title_original: IFC Export Rules Part 2: what parameters to export - dos and don'ts
question_paraphrase: which parameters should I export for QS, coordination, construction and FM?
answer_summary: Never export all parameters, only those in BEP; no schedules/legends/references; do not re-import IFC to native; FM needs a key linking to an external database.

gloss_en: What should a super IFC file look like: header, spatial structure, specific classes, consistent attributes, supported geometry.
title_original: Super IFC
question_paraphrase: file will not open because viewer does not support IFC4X3_ADD2; ObjectType free text is inconsistent
answer_summary: Edit header only as temporary workaround; avoid proxies; plan ObjectType early; prefer Brep; SectionedSolidHorizontal may break viewers.

gloss_en: Revit mapping table is one row per category so a boiler and a heat pump in Mechanical Equipment cannot differ.
title_original: Exporting IFC from Revit Part 1: Mapping
question_paraphrase: how to export different equipment in the same Revit category as different IFC classes?
answer_summary: Add IfcExportAs parameter to family/instance with the target class; load IFC shared parameters; NotExported to exclude categories.

gloss_en: bSDD as the Google Translate of BIM: same concept different names (U-value vs thermal conductivity).
title_original: bSDD - the Google Translate of BIM world
question_paraphrase: different companies name the same object differently and filters miss objects
answer_summary: bSDD gives globally unique identifiers for terms, language independent, with API; not a standard itself but built on IFD (ISO 12006-3).

gloss_en: Secrets of the IFC format: why a neutral format beats point-to-point plug-ins.
title_original: Secrets of the IFC format
question_paraphrase: what is IFC and why not just use native plug-ins; mapping between Revit, Tekla, SmartPlant 3D keeps failing
answer_summary: IFC is semantic and class-based; common structure avoids translators for every pair of programs.

gloss_en: Use ChatGPT to write IfcOpenShell code that renames an element in an IFC.
title_original: Use AI to manipulate your IFC
question_paraphrase: create python code using ifcopenshell to open an IFC and change the name of a wall
answer_summary: Generate code, run, paste errors back, refactor; keep prompts concise and small; accuracy not checked.

gloss_en: Model validation workflow: translate sports facility code into Solibri rules and IDS checks.
title_original: Model validation as a key step in the BIM workflow
question_paraphrase: check that all IfcDoor have Fire Rating in a given pset with allowed values
answer_summary: IDS replaces Excel requirement templates; Solibri 9.13.6+ validates IDS; check LOIN before code checking.

gloss_en: ArchiCAD IFC pain points: stairs drawn as beams, wrong home storey, overlaps break quantities, no BEP.
title_original: Exporting IFC from ARCHICAD
question_paraphrase: contractor needs IFC for cost estimation but we have no BEP or template
answer_summary: Set BEP/template, check classification (Ctrl+T), survey point, only mapped properties, graphic override QA, Publisher sets.

gloss_en: Properties in IFC: pset linkage via relationships, poorly supported property types like IfcPropertyBoundedValue.
title_original: Properties in IFC
question_paraphrase: why do browsers fail on IfcPropertyBoundedValue and TableValue
answer_summary: Only a small part of property/data types is used in practice.

gloss_en: How to inspect raw IFC files and trace errors flagged by the validation service.
title_original: Analyzing IFC files
question_paraphrase: validation report gives errors but how do I find them in the file
answer_summary: Notepad++/VS Code with IFC syntax, IfcQuickBrowser, buildingSMART validation service, IfcOpenShell scripts.

gloss_en: Tekla IFC export: wrong class for braces, choosing export type, misaligned models, rebar in IFC4.
title_original: Export a Tekla Structures model to an IFC file
question_paraphrase: brace exports as IfcMember; how do I choose export type and shrink huge files?
answer_summary: Change entity in IFC export tab, choose Coordination View 2.0 / Surface Geometry / Steel Fabrication View, set base point, use IFC ZIP.

gloss_en: Add custom properties (MMI, Status) to bridge walls in an IFC with IfcOpenShell.
title_original: Add properties to IFC using IfcOpenShell
question_paraphrase: how to add a custom pset to all walls where Domain=Bridge without commercial software
answer_summary: Select by type or property, create pset, link with IfcRelDefinesByProperties, write new file.

gloss_en: Count proxies per storey and source category
prompt: how many IfcBuildingElementProxy in this one and which storeys have the most? need to send it back to the architect
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by storey and ObjectType/Revit category, report with fix suggestions for mapping.

gloss_en: Check extra storeys
prompt: why does the tree show 14 IfcBuildingStorey, bep says 8. which ones are supporting levels?
expected_behavior: List storeys with elevations and element counts, compare to expected count, flag likely supporting levels.

gloss_en: Check why model is far from origin
prompt: model jitters in the viewer, check where the geometry sits vs IfcSite, any map conversion?
expected_behavior: Report bounding box, placement of IfcSite, IfcMapConversion/CRS presence, flag huge coordinates.

gloss_en: Check psets are real standard ones
prompt: list every Pset_ in the file and tell me which arent in the buildingSMART standard
expected_behavior: Enumerate property sets, flag Pset_-prefixed names not in schema, check applicable classes.

gloss_en: IDS style check on fire rating
prompt: do all IfcDoor have FireRating in Pset_DoorCommon, values EI30-EI120 only? list the failing ones
expected_behavior: Query doors, check property and allowed values, list failures with GlobalId/Name.

gloss_en: Compare two exports GlobalIds
prompt: compare v3 and v4 export, guids look different for same pier?? whats really changed
expected_behavior: Match elements by GlobalId then name/placement; report added/removed/changed and GUID instability.

gloss_en: Reclassify wall to footing
prompt: walls named Fundament should be IfcFooting not IfcWall can you fix that
expected_behavior: Find IfcWall by name, change to IfcFooting with appropriate predefined type, warn on schema constraints.

gloss_en: Check base quantities
prompt: do the walls have BaseQuantities? give me total NetVolume per wall type, flag missing
expected_behavior: Read Qto/BaseQuantities, sum per type, list elements without quantities.

gloss_en: Check furniture containment
prompt: furniture sits under storeys not spaces, FM says rooms are empty. confirm?
expected_behavior: List IfcFurnishingElement containers, count under storey vs IfcSpace, report.

gloss_en: Find missing IsExternal
prompt: which columns have no IsExternal in Pset_ColumnCommon
expected_behavior: Query columns, check pset property, list those missing.

gloss_en: Find overly detailed objects
prompt: file is 800MB, what are the heaviest objects, bolts? triangle counts pls
expected_behavior: Estimate representation sizes per class/type, list top offenders, suggest filtering.

gloss_en: Downgrade to 2x3
prompt: need this as ifc2x3 for the contractors site app, whats going to break
expected_behavior: Explain conversion, warn about loss (alignment, classes, properties), run if supported and report differences.

gloss_en: Type parameters missing after update
prompt: updated the ifc exporter and my type params are gone from the psets, what changed
expected_behavior: Explain exporter now needs type class in user-defined pset file and T/I flag; give example.

gloss_en: Different IFC classes in one category
prompt: boiler and heat pump both mechanical equipment, how to export them as different ifc classes
expected_behavior: Recommend IfcExportAs parameter on families, load shared parameters, check result.

gloss_en: Should we require IFC4
prompt: should our EIR demand ifc4 or stay on 2x3? what breaks
expected_behavior: Give balanced view: certification, tool support, model view choice, test before demanding.

gloss_en: Openings not cutting
prompt: linked the ifc but openings dont cut my walls in revit
expected_behavior: Explain ProvisionForVoid, link then bind, trade-offs.

gloss_en: Script to add pset
prompt: write ifcopenshell script adding pset BIMCorner status to all walls
expected_behavior: Provide IfcOpenShell script with pset creation and relationship, caveats.

gloss_en: What is a concept
prompt: whats the difference between mvd, ids and ifc concept? total newbie
expected_behavior: Explain MVD, IDS, concept simply with example.
